objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact subject to creation, editing, release, versioning, and archiving in the P&R Management system

objs.name: policy
objs.description: A Level 1 document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at strategic level

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: A Level 2 document type documenting company-wide or locally defined regulations and instructions

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: A Level 3 document type describing specific procedures, process sequences, details, and responsible persons

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: A Level 4 document type documenting detailed work steps and compliance criteria for sub-processes

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and released directly via switches

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A suggestion for amending an existing document without affecting its content or version history

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to check and extend the validity period of a document approaching expiration

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that has no additional validity

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate and restore a previously invalidated document

objs.name: template
objs.description: A predefined format for creating new documents of a specific document type

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person participating in document management processes with assigned roles and authorizations

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users with shared permissions and roles for document access and actions

objs.name: author
objs.description: A user role responsible for creating and writing document content

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: A user with additional personal change rights on a document without significance in release workflow

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A user role responsible for checking document content according to technical and formal aspects

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A user role responsible for approving and releasing documents for distribution

objs.name: reader
objs.description: A user role permitted only to view approved documents

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A user role permitted to translate released documents into other languages

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A designated user group with read access to archived documents

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: A user group with permission to create reactivation requests

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: A snapshot of a document at a specific point in its lifecycle with associated status and validity

objs.name: signature
objs.description: An electronic confirmation of a workflow participant's completion of their task on a document

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A record of User Groups and persons designated to receive notifications about document release

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A process-supported sequence of document approval steps involving creation, review, and release

objs.name: validity_period
objs.description: The duration for which a released document remains valid before requiring extension or invalidation

objs.name: archive_duration
objs.description: The period for which invalidated documents are retained before physical deletion

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: A translated version of a document in a language other than the original

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: A classification of documents such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction

objs.name: document_property
objs.description: Metadata maintained for a document including references, IT applications, and areas of validity

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Reference information in the system with which documents can be automatically linked

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: A business division or department that documents can reference and be linked to

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A business risk object that documents can reference and be linked to

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: A software system that documents can reference as applicable or relevant

objs.name: client
objs.description: A separate instance in a multi-client system where document visibility can be controlled

objs.name: email_notification
objs.description: An automated message sent to users regarding document release or workflow task status

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: An active confirmation by a user that they have read and understood a distributed document

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Initiate a new document by attaching an information object and selecting a document type

evts.name: select_template
evts.description: Choose a predefined template when creating a new document of a specific type

evts.name: upload_file
evts.description: Attach an external document or file to a document object

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modify the textual or structured content of a document using the editing client

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain metadata, attributes, and configuration settings for a document

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Grant read, write, or other access rights to users or user groups for a document

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Designate a user as reviewer responsible for checking a document during workflow

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Designate a user as releaser responsible for final approval and distribution of a document

evts.name: assign_reader_group
evts.description: Designate a user group as readers with view-only permissions for a document

evts.name: initiate_release_workflow
evts.description: Start the three-step approval process consisting of Creator, Review, and Release steps

evts.name: creator_sign_document
evts.description: The document author electronically signs and confirms the creation of a document

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Examine a document for technical and formal compliance during the review workflow step

evts.name: approve_review
evts.description: Confirm completion of document review positively to allow progression to release

evts.name: reject_review
evts.description: Decline a document during review, terminating the workflow for all subsequent participants

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Approve and finalize a document for distribution to readers during the release workflow step

evts.name: reject_release
evts.description: Decline approval during release, terminating the workflow for all subsequent participants

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Electronically confirm a workflow participant's completion of their document task

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically make a released document visible to designated reader groups

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically transform a document from its source format to PDF after saving

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Generate a new editing version when a released document is revised or modified

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment as no longer relevant to the current document version

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Submit a suggested amendment to a document without modifying the original content

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Plan the implementation of a change proposal, triggering creation of a new document version

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Apply the contents of an approved change proposal to a new document version

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System-generated action when a document reaches 30 days before validity expiration

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirm that a document remains valid and update its expiration date by the standard period

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Initiate the process to invalidate and archive a document with no additional validity

evts.name: approve_override
evts.description: Complete workflow approval to finalize invalidation and archiving of a document

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Withdraw authorizations for a released document and mark it as out of force

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Initiate restoration of a previously invalidated document during the archive retention period

evts.name: approve_reactivation
evts.description: Confirm reactivation and trigger creation of a new version of an archived document

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Restore accessibility and authorizations to a previously invalidated document

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create a language-dependent version of a released document in another language

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Examine translated document content for accuracy and appropriateness

evts.name: approve_translation
evts.description: Confirm translation quality and allow release of the language version

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Finalize a translated document for visibility to readers in the corresponding language

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Assign users or user groups to receive release notifications and acknowledgement requests

evts.name: send_email_distribution
evts.description: Notify assigned users when a new document version is released via email

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Prompt designated recipients to actively confirm receipt and understanding of a document

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Complete a workflow task to verify that a user has received and understood a document

evts.name: view_document
evts.description: Access and read the content of an approved document as an authorized reader

evts.name: access_dashboard
evts.description: Display documents relevant to a user based on distribution list membership and role

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: Produce evaluation summaries of documents and workflow status according to selected parameters

evts.name: link_document_to_master_data
evts.description: Establish a structural connection between a document and reference objects such as processes or organizational units

Document may have translated Language Versions
Document references or is assigned to an Organizational Unit
Document references a Risk in its properties
Document references or is applicable to an IT Application
Document is automatically linked to Master Data objects
Distribution List specifies which users receive notifications for a Document

Co-author is a User with additional change rights
Reviewer is a User assigned to check documents
Releaser is a User responsible for final approval
Reader is a User with view-only permissions
Translator is a User assigned to translate documents
User is a member of a User Group
Archive Group is a designated User Group with archive access
Business Admin Group is a designated User Group for reactivation requests
Signature documents the approval action of a User
Signature is associated with a specific Document Version
Policy is a document type
Guideline is a document type
Procedural Instruction is a document type
Work Instruction is a document type
Policy is classified as a specific Document Type
Guideline is classified as a specific Document Type
Procedural Instruction is classified as a specific Document Type
Work Instruction is classified as a specific Document Type
Email Notification is sent to a User
Email Notification informs about a Document
Acknowledgement is confirmed by a User
Acknowledgement applies to a Document
Document visibility is controlled per Client in a multi-client system

Reader groups are assigned to Document
User Group is assigned as readers
Release workflow is initiated for Document
Request is created for extended validity
Business Admin Group user creates reactivation request
Distribution List is assigned to Document
Document data is included in reports
Document is linked to reference objects
Master Data object is linked to Document
